option_relations.rationale: Rhabdomyosarcoma is a broader category that includes embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma.

Primary cutaneous embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma of the right temple skin, localized, is clinically equivalent to the provided leaf, which specifies embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma of the right temple skin, localized.
Embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma is a broader category that includes the specific localization and primary cutaneous nature mentioned in the leaf.
Ewing Sarcoma is a distinct type of cancer with different immunohistochemical markers and clinical presentation than rhabdomyosarcoma.
